reason: Avoid duplicating a full model metadata snapshot for every measurement, consistent with direct human U21 storage limits.
change: Persist the full actual baseline once. Each prepared record contains a digest computed from the actual snapshot callback, observed changed-parameter versions, observed counters and an exact restoration comparison against the baseline plus declared cumulative versions. Full actual terminal state is persisted once on complete or stop; unavailable capture remains null. This is a compact scoped witness, not independent full parameter-byte hashing.
unchanged: No expected snapshot may be substituted as a caller observation. Actual callbacks must execute exactly once at capture. No N43 retrofit, model execution, fixture rerun or scientific claim.
storage_protection: No weights, activations or whole caches are accepted by the JSON-only API; numeric list contents are not identified as genuine tensors by this storage helper.
